import random
import tkinter as tk

SIZE = 4
CELL = 90
GAP = 10
BOARD_PX = SIZE * CELL + (SIZE + 1) * GAP

TILE_STYLES = {
    2: ("#eee4da", "#776e65"), 4: ("#ede0c8", "#776e65"),
    8: ("#f2b179", "#f9f6f2"), 16: ("#f59563", "#f9f6f2"),
    32: ("#f67c5f", "#f9f6f2"), 64: ("#f65e3b", "#f9f6f2"),
    128: ("#edcf72", "#f9f6f2"), 256: ("#edcc61", "#f9f6f2"),
    512: ("#edc850", "#f9f6f2"), 1024: ("#edc53f", "#f9f6f2"),
    2048: ("#edc22e", "#f9f6f2"),
}
DEFAULT_STYLE = ("#3c3a32", "#f9f6f2")
EMPTY_COLOR = "#cdc1b4"
BOARD_COLOR = "#bbada0"


class Game:
    """Pure 2048 game logic on a SIZE x SIZE grid."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.reset()

    def reset(self):
        self.grid = [[0] * SIZE for _ in range(SIZE)]
        self.score = 0
        self.best_tile = 0
        self.over = False
        self.spawn()
        self.spawn()

    def spawn(self):
        empty = [(r, c) for r in range(SIZE) for c in range(SIZE) if self.grid[r][c] == 0]
        if not empty:
            return False
        r, c = random.choice(empty)
        self.grid[r][c] = 2 if random.random() < 0.9 else 4
        return True

    def highest(self):
        return max(max(row) for row in self.grid)

    @staticmethod
    def _collapse(row):
        tiles = [v for v in row if v]
        out, gained, i = [], 0, 0
        while i < len(tiles):
            if i + 1 < len(tiles) and tiles[i] == tiles[i + 1]:
                value = tiles[i] * 2
                out.append(value)
                gained += value
                i += 2
            else:
                out.append(tiles[i])
                i += 1
        out += [0] * (SIZE - len(out))
        return out, gained

    def move(self, direction):
        if self.over:
            return False
        grid = self.grid
        if direction in ("up", "down"):
            grid = [list(col) for col in zip(*grid)]
        if direction in ("right", "down"):
            grid = [row[::-1] for row in grid]
        new_grid, gained = [], 0
        for row in grid:
            collapsed, add = self._collapse(row)
            gained += add
            new_grid.append(collapsed)
        if direction in ("right", "down"):
            new_grid = [row[::-1] for row in new_grid]
        if direction in ("up", "down"):
            new_grid = [list(col) for col in zip(*new_grid)]
        if new_grid == self.grid:
            return False
        self.grid = new_grid
        self.score += gained
        self.best_tile = max(self.best_tile, self.highest())
        self.spawn()
        if not self.can_move():
            self.over = True
        return True

    def can_move(self):
        for r in range(SIZE):
            for c in range(SIZE):
                if self.grid[r][c] == 0:
                    return True
                if c + 1 < SIZE and self.grid[r][c] == self.grid[r][c + 1]:
                    return True
                if r + 1 < SIZE and self.grid[r][c] == self.grid[r + 1][c]:
                    return True
        return False


class App:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("2048")
        root.resizable(False, False)
        self.game = Game()

        top = tk.Frame(root, bg=BOARD_COLOR)
        top.pack(fill="x", padx=10, pady=(10, 0))
        self.score_var = tk.StringVar(value="Score: 0")
        self.best_var = tk.StringVar(value="Highest tile: 0")
        tk.Label(top, textvariable=self.score_var, font=("Helvetica", 14, "bold"),
                 bg=BOARD_COLOR, fg="white").pack(side="left")
        tk.Label(top, textvariable=self.best_var, font=("Helvetica", 14, "bold"),
                 bg=BOARD_COLOR, fg="white").pack(side="right")
        tk.Button(root, text="New Game", command=self.new_game).pack(pady=(6, 0))

        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(root, width=BOARD_PX, height=BOARD_PX,
                                bg=BOARD_COLOR, highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(padx=10, pady=10)
        self.over_id = None

        for key, direction in (("Left", "left"), ("Right", "right"),
                               ("Up", "up"), ("Down", "down")):
            root.bind("<KeyPress-%s>" % key, lambda e, d=direction: self.step(d))
        root.bind("<KeyPress-n>", lambda e: self.new_game())

        self.draw()

    def new_game(self):
        self.game.reset()
        self.draw()

    def step(self, direction):
        if self.game.move(direction):
            self.draw()
            if self.game.over:
                self.show_game_over()

    def draw(self):
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        for r in range(SIZE):
            for c in range(SIZE):
                x = GAP + c * (CELL + GAP)
                y = GAP + r * (CELL + GAP)
                value = self.game.grid[r][c]
                if value == 0:
                    self.canvas.create_rectangle(x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL,
                                                 fill=EMPTY_COLOR, outline="")
                else:
                    fill, fg = TILE_STYLES.get(value, DEFAULT_STYLE)
                    self.canvas.create_rectangle(x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL,
                                                 fill=fill, outline="")
                    font_size = 26 if value < 100 else 22 if value < 1000 else 16
                    self.canvas.create_text(x + CELL / 2, y + CELL / 2, text=str(value),
                                            fill=fg, font=("Helvetica", font_size, "bold"))
        self.score_var.set("Score: %d" % self.game.score)
        self.best_var.set("Highest tile: %d" % self.game.best_tile)

    def show_game_over(self):
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(GAP, BOARD_PX / 2 - 40, BOARD_PX - GAP,
                                     BOARD_PX / 2 + 40, fill="#8f7a66", outline="")
        self.canvas.create_text(BOARD_PX / 2, BOARD_PX / 2, text="Game Over!  Press N for a new game",
                                fill="white", font=("Helvetica", 16, "bold"))


def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    App(root)
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            root.bind("<KeyPress-%s>" % key, lambda e, d=direction: self.step(d))
        root.bind("<KeyPress-n>", lambda e: self.new_game())
        root.bind("<KeyPress-N>", lambda e: self.new_game())

        self.draw()

    def new_game(self):
        self.game.reset()
        self.draw()

    def step(self, direction):
        if self.game.move(direction):
            self.draw()
            if self.game.over:
                self.show_game_over()

    def draw(self):
        self.canvas.delete("all")
        for r in range(SIZE):
            for c in range(SIZE):
                x = GAP + c * (CELL + GAP)
                y = GAP + r * (CELL + GAP)
                value = self.game.grid[r][c]
                if value == 0:
                    self.canvas.create_rectangle(x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL,
                                                 fill=EMPTY_COLOR, outline="")
                else:
                    fill, fg = TILE_STYLES.get(value, DEFAULT_STYLE)
                    self.canvas.create_rectangle(x, y, x + CELL, y + CELL,
                                                 fill=fill, outline="")
                    size = 26 if value < 100 else 22 if value < 1000 else 16
                    self.canvas.create_text(x + CELL / 2, y + CELL / 2, text=str(value),
                                            fill=fg, font=("Helvetica", size, "bold"))
        self.score_var.set("Score: %d" % self.game.score)
        self.best_var.set("Highest tile: %d" % self.game.best_tile)

    def show_game_over(self):
        self.canvas.create_rectangle(GAP, BOARD_PX / 2 - 40, BOARD_PX - GAP,
                                     BOARD_PX / 2 + 40, fill="#8f7a66", outline="")
        self.canvas.create_text(BOARD_PX / 2, BOARD_PX / 2,
                                text="Game Over!  Press N for a new game",
                                fill="white", font=("Helvetica", 15, "bold"))


def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    App(root)
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
